calculation.description: For each tradable asset, take the negative lagged 3-session return (reversal), activated only when cross-asset return dispersion is above its trailing 60-session median. Dispersion is the cross-sectional mean absolute deviation of daily returns from the cross-sectional median. Signals are lagged by using completed data through t. Cross-sectionally median-center the activated signal for portfolio use.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR remained positive across reported regimes: 2020-2022 IC +0.057174/ICIR +0.164549; 2023-2024 +0.043035/+0.121606; 2025-2026 +0.043298/+0.125519; 2026-07 onward +0.032011/+0.099599. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
validation.validation_method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against forward close-to-close return, using completed prices only; all 15 tradable benchmark instruments and dates with at least 8 valid names.
